title: AIrth – AI for Energy Efficiency and Emissions Reduction
summary: AIrth has tested an energy-insight prototype with simulated data and plans pilots with Georgian businesses and households.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The prototype combines AI and connected-device information to recommend more efficient energy use. Its current tests use simulated data. Business and residential pilots, real-world data collection, and appliance integration are planned, so the described energy and emissions benefits remain prospective.
purpose: Help businesses and households understand and reduce energy use.

ratings.reason: AIrth has only simulated-data testing; SME pilots and real-world behavioral validation are planned.
Residential energy savings have not been demonstrated.
Emissions reduction remains an intended effect.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: AIrth – AI for Energy Efficiency and Emissions Reduction

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AIrth proposes accessible energy and emissions insights
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
